brand_identity.name: Sevora
design_principles: Precision over Decoration: Every pixel must serve the data or the aesthetic.
Editorial Density: High information density, but styled like a magazine spread.
Sharpness: 0px or 2px border radius. No friendly round blobs.
The 'Vogue' Grid: Asymmetrical layouts for dashboards, strict tables for data.
Texture: Subtle noise or paper grain on backgrounds to avoid digital sterility.

headings.usage: Page titles, Hero sections, Key metrics

primary.description: Deep Emerald - Represents wealth, growth, and style.

accent.description: Metallic Gold - Used for high-value borders or active states.

radius.instruction: Use sharp edges (0px) for cards and containers. Use small radius (2px) for buttons. Use full radius only for status badges.

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-xs px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-xs px-6 py-3

cards.classes: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm rounded-none p-6

inputs.classes: rounded-none border-x-0 border-t-0 border-b border-input bg-transparent px-0 focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-primary placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

tables.header: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-muted-foreground border-b border-border pb-4

charts_and_viz.style: Minimalist, thin lines, no grid lines

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add Playfair Display and Manrope from Google Fonts in index.css immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the specified colors (emerald, gold) and radius (0px/2px).
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Modify ui/button.tsx, ui/card.tsx, ui/input.tsx to match the 'Sharp & Luxury' aesthetic defined in component_rules.
4. LAYOUT: Build the sidebar to be sleek and dark (Emerald #064E3B) or Stark White with a border. Prefer Stark White with a simplified logo.
5. FORMS: Use the 'Underline' input style for a cleaner, high-fashion look instead of standard boxed inputs.
6. TABLES: Ensure table headers are uppercase and tracked-out (letter-spacing: wider).
7. IMAGES: Use the provided image URLs for mock data in the Stylist and Wedding Planner modules.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use flat colors or subtle textures.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings.
Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp.
